snippet.title: Dirt Digger LIVE - Running the Excavator on the Big Map - REAL Dirt Physics
snippet.description:
Dirt Digger is out now in early access. Buy the game here: https://www.zirtola.com

It's early access, so it isn't finished: expect bugs, rough edges and a lot more to come. Bug reports and ideas go on the forum at https://www.zirtola.com

Watch how it was made, from the first build: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQIpAE5RQP4Y
